title.part2: we all have the power to act on our salmon consumption.

recommendations.title: Reduce your salmon consumption
recommendations.description:
The first step to reducing your impact is to decrease your consumption.

Dividing our national consumption by 3 would already severely limit the pressures exerted on the Ocean, animals, and humans.

While this can be done gradually, the most effective choice remains to stop consuming salmon altogether.

Why ? Because it has an immediate positive impact on animals and the Ocean. Our food choices have real power : when demand changes, supply chains adapt. By choosing to no longer buy salmon from problematic production methods, we send a strong signal to the industry and encourage the development of more respectful alternatives.

recommendations.title: Continue eating iodine-rich foods (without fish)
recommendations.description: The pleasure of an iodine-rich cuisine does not rely solely on fish. Algae, shellfish, and new ways of cooking allow you to rediscover marine flavors while diversifying your diet. Try our fish-free marine menus now, with 100% ocean-inspired and plant-based recipes, to make your taste buds dance without emptying the Ocean !

recommendations.title: Introduce plant-based alternatives into your diet
recommendations.description: Today, there are many plant-based alternatives to continue enjoying the recipes we love : plant-based smoked salmon, steaks, spreads, or preparations inspired by seafood. These alternatives allow you to rediscover familiar textures, uses, and pleasures, while reducing the impact linked to salmon consumption.

recommendations.title: Raise awareness around you
recommendations.description: Most people are still unaware of the real impacts linked to salmon consumption. Sharing this information around you, opening up the discussion, and introducing other ways to consume are also forms of action. The more of us who understand the issues, the more we can change practices.

title.part3: It is urgent to get them on board.

recommendations.title: I ask to reduce or remove salmon-based dishes from the cafeteria
recommendations.description:
Changing a corporate restaurant menu can have a strong impact.

By bringing this topic to your company, you are concretely shifting the lines.

actions.cta: Ask us for help to convince internally

recommendations.title: I propose 100% plant-based event catering
recommendations.description:
Meetings, seminars, cocktails, corporate events… all opportunities to introduce another way to enjoy food.

General or plant-based specialized caterers today offer creative, gourmet, and inclusive alternatives that more easily meet different dietary habits while limiting environmental impact.

recommendations.title: I request support from Seastemik
recommendations.description:
Every company can engage in powerful transformations. Seastemik can support you in initiating this change with your teams.

It is urgent, possible (and joyful) to remove fish from catering food to move towards an offer aligned with the 10kg of fish consumption per year and per inhabitant in France.
